name: Paracetamol
caution: Avoid with liver disease or heavy alcohol use.

name: Ibuprofen
caution: Take with food; avoid with kidney disease, ulcers, or in late pregnancy.

name: Amoxicillin
max_daily: 1500mg (standard adult course; higher for severe infections per prescriber)
caution: Complete the full course. Avoid if allergic to penicillin.

name: Insulin
typical_dose: Individualized — based on blood glucose, weight, and regimen; never a fixed OTC dose.
caution: Dosing must be set by a treating physician. Never adjust without medical guidance. Watch for hypoglycemia (shakiness, sweating, confusion).

name: Aspirin
use: Pain relief, fever reducer, and (low-dose) blood clot prevention.
typical_dose: 300-900mg every 4-6h for pain, max 4000mg/day; 75-150mg/day for cardio-protection.
caution: Avoid in children/teens with viral illness (Reye's syndrome risk). Increases bleeding risk.

name: Metformin
use: First-line oral medication for type 2 diabetes.
typical_dose: 500mg once or twice daily, titrated up to 2000mg/day max.
caution: Take with food to reduce GI upset. Avoid in severe kidney disease.

name: Amlodipine
use: Calcium channel blocker for high blood pressure.
caution: May cause ankle swelling and dizziness; rise slowly from sitting/lying.

name: Cetirizine
caution: May cause drowsiness in some people.

name: Omeprazole
use: Proton pump inhibitor for acid reflux and ulcers.
caution: Long-term use linked to lower magnesium/B12; discuss duration with your doctor.

name: Atorvastatin
caution: Report unexplained muscle pain. Avoid grapefruit juice in large amounts.

name: Warfarin
caution: Narrow therapeutic window — many food/drug interactions. Requires regular blood tests.

name: Azithromycin
use: Antibiotic for bacterial infections (respiratory, skin, STIs).
typical_dose: 500mg on day 1, then 250mg daily for 4 more days (typical course).
caution: Can prolong QT interval; caution with existing heart rhythm issues.
